title: LIVE Trading
subtitle: The gated LIVE spot-trading control plane: safety gates, server NAV, broker connections, orders and the append-only ledger. All numbers travel as Decimal strings — the browser never computes risk.

nav.disabledTitle: LIVE trading has not been enabled for this environment.

unavailable.title: LIVE trading console unavailable
unavailable.description: The trading safety-status endpoint is not available (404/501). No LIVE trading UI is rendered and no data is fabricated.
unavailable.hint: If you expect LIVE trading here, the backend LIVE control plane endpoints are either not deployed or disabled in this environment.

liveDisabled.title: LIVE trading is disabled
liveDisabled.description: Every LIVE gate defaults to OFF. This page renders no trading UI while LIVE is disabled — it only shows the honest gate status, never fabricated data.
liveDisabled.applyDescription: LIVE trading requires an administrator-approved eligibility review, an approved production mandate, a healthy broker connection and a clean reconciliation. Check your account page for the current approval status.

pendingApproval.title: LIVE approval pending
pendingApproval.description: The deployment gates passed, but your account has not been approved for LIVE trading yet. The server refuses LIVE order submission until the eligibility review completes.

killed.title: Kill switch engaged
killed.description: A kill switch is active. All new LIVE orders are blocked; queries, cancels, fill recording and reconciliation keep working. Recovery always requires a human admin release.

paused.title: LIVE mandate paused
paused.description: One or more LIVE mandates are paused. New orders are blocked until the mandate is resumed with its confirmation phrase.

ready.title: LIVE ready
ready.description: All gates passed. Every preview and submission still passes through the server-side risk engine; this page only displays state and submits intent.

overview.navUnavailable: No NAV snapshot exists yet for the trading account.
overview.noConnections: No broker connection bound yet. Bind a spot-only, read-enabled API key on the Connect page.
overview.noMandates: No LIVE mandate exists yet. Mandates are created and approved by an administrator.

emergency.title: Pause LIVE trading
emergency.description: Pausing blocks all new orders under your LIVE mandates. Queries, cancels, fill recording and reconciliation keep working. Recovery requires the mandate resume confirmation phrase.
emergency.noMandates: No active LIVE mandates to pause.
emergency.failed: Pause failed. Check the reason and try again.

connect.title: Bind broker credentials
connect.description: Credentials are encrypted by the server (Fernet/KMS) and are never written to this browser — not localStorage, not cookies, not logs.
connect.securityNotice: Create an API key with SPOT TRADING + READ ONLY permissions only. Withdrawal, transfer, margin and leverage must stay DISABLED on the exchange. PureGamma encrypts credentials at rest and hard-denies withdrawal/transfer by policy.
connect.requiredFields: Provider, API key and API secret are required.
connect.unavailableError: This endpoint is not available yet: the LIVE credential-binding API has not been opened on the server. Nothing was submitted or stored.
connect.success: Connection bound. Run a health test to see the gateway result.
connect.healthDisabledNote: The execution gateway is in mock mode and honestly reports DISABLED — no order will ever touch a real broker until a real adapter is provisioned.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Two-step flow: preview runs the 14-check server risk engine, then confirm submits the intent. Every confirm action requires a second confirmation dialog.
orders.noMandates: No LIVE mandate available to trade under. Mandates are created and approved by an administrator.
orders.rejectedTitle: Order rejected by the risk engine
orders.rejectedHint: The confirm action stays disabled while any check fails.
orders.confirmationToken: Confirmation token — copy it and paste it below to confirm.
orders.confirmDialogBody: Review the order before submitting. This submits a LIVE spot order through the trading control plane and cannot be undone.
orders.submitted: Order submitted. Watch its status below.
orders.confirmError: Confirmation failed. The token may not match the preview; the server never retries blindly.
orders.cancelConfirmBody: Cancellation stays allowed even while kill switches are engaged. Only open orders can be canceled.
orders.fillsUnavailable: Fill details are not exposed through the user API yet; fills are recorded server-side with the order and visible in the admin console.

account.title: Account
account.description: Balances, ledger-derived positions, reconciliation status and mandate limits. All monetary values are server-computed Decimal strings.
account.ledgerUnavailable: The user-facing ledger list is not exposed by the API yet. Ledger entries are append-only (9 entry types) and visible in the admin console; history is never rewritten.
